fact: ANGOP reported that Banco Angolano de Investimentos and Bank of China signed an MoU on 8 September 2026 for an RMB clearing account and support for BAI's indirect CIPS membership through Bank of China.

Banco Angolano de Investimentos and Bank of China's Luanda branch signed a memorandum on 8 September 2026 to open a renminbi clearing account, develop RMB settlement and clearing services and support BAI's indirect accession to China's CIPS cross-border interbank payment system, with no live date stated (Mercado).
SADC states that on 27 July 2026 the Angolan kwanza was introduced as a settlement currency in the SADC-RTGS system, the second after the rand, which 15 countries use.
SADC says 2025 trade and interbank transactions between Angola and the other 14 SADC states were about US$3.77 billion across nine currencies, South Africa taking about US$2.99 billion.
BNA governor Manuel Tiago Dias announced that the Kwanza will join the SADC-RTGS real-time payment system from the second half of 2026.
Angola takes part in the SADC-RTGS, the regional settlement system, with the kwanza as its second settlement currency since 2026-07-27.
The State, firms and households can make cross-border payments for goods and services through SADC-RTGS via five participating commercial banks, per BNA payments director Cristina Canico.

Afrimoney's executive council chair told Economia e Mercado at ANGOTIC 2025 that Afrimoney lets people in Angola receive money in kwanza in real time from countries including Portugal, Brazil, DR Congo, Namibia, Mozambique and South Africa; outbound is not yet live.
